{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the total number of penguins in the dataset
print(f"Total number of penguins in the dataset: {len(penguins)}")

# Check if the two missing values in flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g are the same two rows
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()
missing_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()

# Find the indices where both are missing
both_missing = missing_flipper & missing_mass

print(f"Number of penguins with missing values in both flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g: {both_missing.sum()}")

# Display the rows with missing values in either
print("Rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g:")
print(penguins[both_missing])"}
